headline: 10-year yield hits highest since January 2025 as higher oil prices stoke inflation worries
detail: Rising yields and inflation fears are a headwind for growth and tech stocks, especially leveraged ones. This environment can lead to increased volatility and pressure on your concentrated tech holdings.
rec: Consider trimming SOXL and SMH given the rising yield and inflation concerns, which are negative for leveraged tech.

headline: Suddenly Wall Street is getting a bit nervous. Here are two ways to prepare for turbulence.
